interface_checks.subject: Graph registration
interface_checks.assessment: ar.capture encloses torch.cuda.graph and registers graph buffers on context exit. Captured calls use registered=True. Replay follows registration.

interface_checks.subject: Exact primitive selection
interface_checks.assessment: Disabled CustomAllreduce and either None return fail. All frozen payloads satisfy 16-byte divisibility and the default <8 MiB limit.

interface_checks.subject: Two groups
interface_checks.assessment: Gloo WORLD handles control and CustomAllreduce metadata. The separate all-rank NCCL group handles AG and SUM RS. Installed CustomAllreduce rejects NCCL as its metadata group.

interface_checks.subject: Stock collectives
interface_checks.assessment: Default async_op=False retains Work.wait stream ordering. reduce_scatter_tensor defaults to SUM. Runtime graph compatibility still needs capture and output gates.

interface_checks.subject: Padding and exact expectations
interface_checks.assessment: All 12 frozen P/C cases have consistent owner order, zero padding and RS=owned*P. AR first/second values are 3/6 at P2 and 10/40 at P4.

interface_checks.subject: Buffer lifetime
interface_checks.assessment: Input/owner tensors remain unchanged during each cell. Graphs and final outputs remain referenced through all replays. Each cell finishes before the next shape. No replay is authorized after teardown.

interface_checks.subject: Timing
interface_checks.assessment: Each event span encloses a graph with 16 complete serialized pairs. The summary selects the per-trial maximum rank-local duration. It does not combine component maxima or establish globally aligned makespan.

tests.harness_limit: The first fake harness omitted the fake torch.distributed attribute and failed before setup. The corrected harness passes. This was a review-harness error, not a probe error.

admission_obligations: Use a fresh guarded output directory and the exact ordered physical mask.
Require all captured functional fixture checks to pass on every rank before using timing.
Require successful outer guard, expected completed cells and rank-local cleanup records without errors.
Rank-0 status success alone is insufficient because it precedes cleanup.
Retain capture failures, partial CPU rows and failed guards. Do not relax the frozen protocol.
No claim of recovery from fatal CUDA errors or peer failure follows from local cleanup.
claim_limits: Direct CustomAllreduce service is not the complete native TP dispatcher, model graph, or strongest native baseline.
AR/AR and AG/RS do not represent identical complete layer functions without omitted model operators.
Padding, launches and registered custom-AR graph operations are charged. Packing, attention, MLP, norms, gate, KV, scheduling and model state are absent.
Logical tensor capacities are not measured wire bytes, HBM reads, pure bandwidth, or critical-path shares.
Stock NCCL AG/RS does not exhaust fused or optimized hybrids.
A faster pair is a component opportunity. A slower pair is narrow evidence against the named stock service premise, not a universal architecture rejection.
Hidden-width compatibility does not validate either Base model or fixed/adaptive execution.
